function.name: bash
function.description: Run a shell command and return its output. Use a timeout for long commands.

timeout_s.description: Seconds before the command is stopped

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file. Read only the lines you need.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create a file or replace it completely. Read an existing file first.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact string in a file. The old string must be unique.

function.name: search
function.description: Search file contents with a regex, or list files with a glob.

function.name: latent_checkpoint
function.description: Save the current context as a state handle on this engine. Returns the handle id, the token position and the size in bytes. Max 8 live handles.

function.name: latent_handoff
function.description: Continue from a state handle on another engine that shares the weights. The target answers the instruction and returns its text. The handle is not consumed.

instruction.description: Text that follows the saved context; start with a non-space character

function.name: latent_release
function.description: Free a state handle. Call this after the handle has been used.

function.name: latent_list
function.description: List live state handles with id, position and size.

function.name: crew_assign
function.description: Give one task to a worker. Returns the worker note as text.

task.description: One task with the expected output

function.name: crew_note
function.description: Send a short text note to another team member. Use it when a state handle is not worth its cost.
